welcomesubheader: A quality-of-life and data tracking framework for the game Faster Than Light.
welcomefirst: First, we need to find where your game is located.
welcomeopt2: window (which may also be accessed using the wrench icon in the sidebar), and configure the path to the FTL executable using the Browse button.
langconfirm: Changing the language requires reloading the user interface. Do you wish to do this now?
settings_ftl_loc_long: This should be set to the main FTL game executable (FTLGame.exe). Please see the online documentation page for more information on how to locate this for common versions installed through Steam, GoG, etc.
settings_ftl_compat_full_tip: The version of FTL that was selected is fully compatible. All Subspace features are available.
settings_ftl_compat_partial_tip: The version of FTL that was selected is partially compatible. Basic functionality will work, but some features are not available.
settings_ftl_compat_incompat_tip: The version of FTL that was selected is invalid or is not compatible with Subspace.
settings_ftl_compat_unknown_tip: No file is selected or the compatibility is otherwise unknown.
settings_saveoverride_tip:
By default FTL stores its save files under the user's Documents folder.

This option allows you to choose a different location to store the save files instead.
settings_saveoverride_user_tip:
Instead of a fixed location, store the save files under a "user" subfolder of the FTL game installation.

This can be useful if you switch between different copies of the game and want to use a different profile for each.
ftl_howtoplay3: Or load historical data using the menu.
ftl_newgame: To start a run, begin a new game or continue a saved game in FTL.
ftl_gopractice: Alternatively, if the practice mode feature is enabled, you can load a practice save through the menu.
settings_features_explainer:
Tip: Once setup is complete, go to the Features page on the left and activate one or more features.

By default Subspace behaves as pure vanilla FTL. Enabling features allows you to choose exactly which modifications you wish to use. Once features are activated, more settings will appear that can be used to configure them further.
settings_features_instruction: Click on the panels below to enable or disable the feature.
feature_frameadv_desc: Use a key to advance the game state by a single frame while paused, for convenience as well to assist players who find micropausing physically difficult.
feature_infoblock_desc: Display a customizable block of information in the top-right corner of the screen, such as game version or FPS.
feature_numerichull_desc: Show remaining hull integrity in numeric form, without having to count the bars by hand.
feature_timewarp_desc: Speed up time to skip over the boring parts.
feature_tweaks_desc: A catch-all feature for one-off tweaks that do not fit into any other category.
timewarp_maxwarp_tip: Limits the maximum time warp factor.
timewarp_doubletap_tip:
When enabled, requires pressing the 'increase warp factor' key binding twice to reach this level or higher.

This helps prevent accidentally accelerating time too fast to control.
timewarp_allowslowmo_tip: Allows the warp factor to be set to values less than 1x, effectively running the game in slow motion.
infoblock_instructions: Use the panel below to order the lines to be displayed in the information block:
frameadv_advance_tip: Steps time forward by a single frame, pausing the game if necessary.
timewarp_increase_tip: Enters time warp mode and doubles the flow of time.
timewarp_decrease_tip: While in time warp mode, halves the flow of time.
timewarp_cancel_tip: Exits time warp mode and returns the flow of time to normal.
keybind_instructions: To bind a key, click on the command button below, then press the desired key. Clicking elsewhere will cancel. Pressing Escape will unbind the key.
keybind_note: Please note that only keys that are recognized by the FTL game itself can be bound. When using international layouts, many accented and special characters cannot be bound as a result. Keys that require a modifier to be pressed also will not function for the same reason. These key bindings will override FTL's in-game key bindings if there is a conflict!
tweaks_targetfps_desc:
Changes the target framerate when the frame limiter is ON.
NOTE: This may have no effect if vertical sync is enabled in your graphics driver settings.
ftl_tutorial_text: Well, I'm not going to judge... much.
feature_practicemode_desc: Adds a menu option to load a specific save file for practice, without affecting achievements or statistics.
feature_runtracker_desc: Records and saves detailed information about each run. Cannot be enabled or disabled while a run is in progress.
feature_savemanager_desc: Copies the save file at each beacon, so that the copy can be loaded back in to practice mode later. Requires the Run Tracker feature.
tweaks_preserveload_tip: Prevents the game from deleting the continue.sav file upon load a saved game from the menu.
tweaks_savecompat_tip:
Alters the behaviour of saving games to write to a temporary file and then rename it into place when complete.
This increases compatibility with third-party tools that read the save file while the game is running.
tweaks_postgamesave_tip: Creates one additional save file after victory/defeat, allowing data analysis tools such as FTL Hindsight to be able to record hull damage in the final Flagship phase.
tweaks_creditsmusic_tip:
When the credits roll after a victory, instead of playing the title screen music, play a unique track called 'credits'.
A separate data mod to provide this track is required.
quitconfirm:
Warning! FTL is still running and a tracked run is in progress.
Closing Subspace will disrupt run tracking and may result in missing data.

Are you sure?
runtracker_ready: Run Tracker is ready - new runs will be recorded
runtracker_recording: Run Tracker is recording data from a run
runtracker_paused: Run Tracker is paused - new runs will NOT be recorded
settings_rundirfmt_long:
Run folders are created underneath "runs" in the Subspace install folder and contain save files, run logs, etc.

This setting controls how the subfolder for each run is named.
settings_rundirvar_list: Variables that may be used in the run folder format are: ${year}, ${month}, ${day}, ${hour}, ${minute}, ${second}, ${shipname}, ${shiptype}, ${difficulty}, and ${seed}.
settings_savenamefmt_long: This pattern is used to name the archived save files. It should NOT include the .sav file extension.
settings_savenamevar_list: Variables that may be used in the save file name format are: ${year}, ${month}, ${day}, ${hour}, ${minute}, ${second}, ${shipname}, ${shiptype}, ${beacon}, ${sector}, ${event}, and ${othership}.
runhistory_abandon_confirm: Marking the run as abandoned should be done only if it is never going to be resumed. Are you sure?
runhistory_delete_confirm: Caution! Deleting the run will permanently remove its information from the database! Are you sure you want to do this?
practicemode_revert_tip: While in practice mode, revert to the last loaded save.
practicemode_cheats_tip: While in practice mode, open a menu of useful cheats.
gameinfo_practice_text: Run information is not collected while in practice mode.
feature_screenshot_desc: Take screenshots with a hotkey, or automatically on certain events.
screenshot_take_tip: Saves the current game screen to a file.
